name: client-2026-dll-loader
summary: 2026 client: import fiestahook.dll, so client features can be written as hook plugins (hooks/*.dll beside Fiesta.exe).
status: BUILT 2026-09-24, not yet run in a live client.
why: THE TARGET IS Fiesta.exe (2026-09-15, 9,264,128 B), not the stale Fiesta.bin beside it.
The same import injection as zone/recipes/dll-loader.json: the import descriptor array is copied into a new
section with fiestahook.dll appended and the import directory pointed at the copy; nothing in .text changes.
Safe for the same reason: Fiesta.exe has no bound-import directory (checked at apply time).
The loader (common/loader) is shared with the servers. A server is a Windows service and loads its plugins
when ServiceMain starts; the client is not, so the loader's CLIENT MODE swaps the CreateWindowExA import and
loads hooks/*.dll on the first call - WinMain on the main thread, everything initialised, no window yet.
With no plugins the client runs exactly as before (the loader logs to fiestahook.log beside the exe).
Deploy: fiestahook.dll next to Fiesta.exe, plugins in a hooks/ subfolder. XIGNCODE must already be
neutralised (Client2026patched is): an injected DLL is exactly what it scans for.
